differences: Seeded synthetic data, not measurements from the named original benchmark.
One 110×12 correlated design, five penalties and 24 bootstraps replace 256 datasets, two consistency regimes, 16 features and up to 256 bootstraps.
Fixed training standardization and SSE/(2n) penalty convention; no reproduction of Bach consistency curves or P(correct support).
